name: hyperframes
description: Deterministic, LOCAL, FREE video from code — render an HTML/CSS/JS composition to MP4 via the HyperFrames CLI (npx, pinned, Apache-2.0) in a bundled headless Chromium + system ffmpeg. Zero inference cost; the composition source is git-tracked and the MP4 is regenerable. Best for structured motion graphics (product demos, changelog clips, explainers). Needs Node 22+. NOT generative/paid AI video (that is the separate video plugin); NOT a still image (diagram/image).

ffmpeg.manual: Install ffmpeg (HyperFrames requires it for MP4 encoding) — Debian/Ubuntu `sudo apt install ffmpeg`; Fedora `sudo dnf install ffmpeg`; Arch `sudo pacman -S ffmpeg`; macOS `brew install ffmpeg`. (HyperFrames manages its own headless Chromium — no separate browser install needed.)
